lines.text: The Lord GOD prepared swarms of locusts, Amos asked forgiveness because Jacob was so small, and the LORD relented.
In the second vision, the Lord GOD called for judgment by fire, which consumed the great deep and devoured the land.
Amos asked the Lord GOD to stop the fire, and the LORD said it would not happen either.
The Lord stood by a wall with a plumb line and said He was setting it among the Philistines.
The Lord said the high places of Isaac would be deserted, and He would rise against Jeroboam's house with a staff.
